name: startup
description: Startup into full load, minimum load, and an unprotected near-short, all in one tran run
claim: README.md Target specification, 'Startup' row (DR-0004 amendment A9): monotonic into any load 0-50 mA, controlled ramp <=1V/ms, inside +/-2% within 3 ms of enable, overshoot <=+2%. Measured here for full load (~50 mA) and minimum/no external load. The third branch (near-short, 'startup into current limit') is honest evidence against the CURRENT design state only: no current-limit/foldback circuitry exists yet (issue #11 is open -- design/README.md documents the current-sense tap as unimplemented), so this branch measures inrush into an UNPROTECTED near-short, not a current-limit verification, and carries no pass/fail checks (there is nothing ratified to check it against yet). Re-run once #11 lands a real current limit.
analyses: meas tran t_settle_full WHEN v(vout_full)=1.782 RISE=1 TD=1u
meas tran vpeak_full MAX v(vout_full) FROM=1u TO=6m
meas tran t_settle_min WHEN v(vout_min)=1.782 RISE=1 TD=1u
meas tran vpeak_min MAX v(vout_min) FROM=1u TO=6m
meas tran vpeak_short MAX v(vout_short) FROM=1u TO=6m
meas tran vfinal_short FIND v(vout_short) AT=6m
meas tran ipeak_short MAX i(vamm_short) FROM=1u TO=6m

operating_conditions.load_current: ~50 mA (Rload_full=36 Ohm), ~1 uA (Rload_min=1.8 MOhm, minimum/no external load), near-short (Rload_short=1 Ohm, unprotected -- see Claim)
operating_conditions.output_cap: 4.7 uF (DR-0001 window's upper bound, the softest/slowest startup corner) + 100 mOhm ESR, all three branches
operating_conditions.enable_state: EN steps 0 -> VIN at t=1us (1ns edges) for all three branches simultaneously

tsettle_full_ms.description: README.md Startup target: inside +/-2% within 3 ms, full load

overshoot_full_mv.description: README.md Startup target: overshoot <=+2% of final value (1.836V ceiling), full load

tsettle_min_ms.description: README.md Startup target: inside +/-2% within 3 ms, minimum load

overshoot_min_mv.description: README.md Startup target: overshoot <=+2% of final value (1.836V ceiling), minimum load
